PCL 1.15.1 (vendored subset for VisionPlatform 3D plugins)
Modules: common, filters, sample_consensus, segmentation, registration, search, kdtree, octree, features, ml
3rdParty: Eigen3 + Boost headers + FLANN headers
Skipped: VTK / OpenNI2 / Qhull / Boost lib / unused PCL modules
No system PCL_ROOT required.
